external_entities.name: colleagues
external_entities.description: People who sign in through the identity broker.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Colleagues sign in to it from wherever they are
external_entities.notes: The text does not state whether colleagues are asked for a second factor.

external_entities.name: own devices at home
external_entities.description: Devices used by colleagues to sign in from home.
external_entities.source_excerpt: including their own devices at home

external_entities.name: franchise colleagues
external_entities.description: Colleagues from franchise stores who authenticate through their own identity provider.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Franchise colleagues do not have staff accounts with us
external_entities.notes: The text does not state which franchise colleagues the identity provider is allowed to vouch for.

external_entities.name: franchise identity provider
external_entities.description: An identity provider operated for franchise colleagues that vouches for them to the broker.
external_entities.source_excerpt: their own identity provider vouches for them
external_entities.notes: The text does not state which colleagues this provider is allowed to vouch for.

processes.name: identity broker
processes.description: Signs colleagues in, issues tokens, accepts sign-in assertions from the franchise identity provider, maintains directory membership, signs tokens, and writes sign-ins to an audit log.
processes.source_excerpt: Everything colleagues use signs them in through one identity broker.
processes.notes: The text does not state whether colleagues are asked for a second factor.

processes.name: store admin console
processes.description: An application that uses the token's groups to authorize store administration, including changing prices and voiding transactions.
processes.source_excerpt: The store admin console is one of those applications.
processes.notes: The console does not check which store the colleague belongs to, so a store-manager token works against every store.

processes.name: HR system
processes.description: The system from which colleague group membership changes are pulled overnight.
processes.source_excerpt: it comes from the HR system overnight

data_stores.name: key store
data_stores.description: A store holding the signing key used by the identity broker to sign tokens for every application.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The broker signs tokens with a signing key it keeps in a key store.
data_stores.notes: The text does not state whether the key store is encrypted where it sits.

data_stores.name: directory
data_stores.description: The identity broker's directory containing colleagues and the groups they are in.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The broker keeps the colleagues and the groups they are in its own directory.
data_stores.notes: The text does not state whether the directory is encrypted where it sits.

data_stores.name: audit log
data_stores.description: A log to which the identity broker writes sign-ins.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The broker writes sign-ins to an audit log.
data_stores.notes: Nobody has written down what the log records or whether it covers the franchise route. The text does not state whether the log is encrypted where it sits.

data_flows.name: sign in
data_flows.description: Colleagues sign in to the identity broker.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Colleagues sign in to it from wherever they are

data_flows.name: vouch for colleagues
data_flows.description: The franchise identity provider vouches for franchise colleagues and the broker takes that as a sign-in.
data_flows.source_excerpt: their own identity provider vouches for them and the broker takes that as a sign-in
data_flows.notes: The text does not state which colleagues the provider is allowed to vouch for.

data_flows.name: issue token
data_flows.description: The identity broker issues a token to the store admin console for authorization.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Every application takes that token and decides what the colleague may do from the groups in it.
data_flows.notes: The token carries the colleague's staff id and a list of the groups they are in.
data_flows.data_description: Token containing staff id and group membership

data_flows.name: fetch public key
data_flows.description: The store admin console fetches the public half of the signing key from the identity broker to check token signatures.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Applications fetch the public half from the broker to check the signature.
data_flows.data_description: Public half of the token-signing key

data_flows.name: read signing key
data_flows.description: The identity broker reads the signing key it uses to sign tokens from the key store.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker signs tokens with a signing key it keeps in a key store.

data_flows.name: pull changes
data_flows.description: The identity broker pulls group membership changes from the HR system once a night.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker pulls the changes once a night
data_flows.notes: The changes also determine how leavers stop being colleagues.

data_flows.name: maintain membership
data_flows.description: The identity broker maintains colleagues and their group memberships in its directory.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker keeps the colleagues and the groups they are in its own directory.

data_flows.name: write sign-ins
data_flows.description: The identity broker writes sign-ins to the audit log.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker writes sign-ins to an audit log.
data_flows.notes: The text does not state whether this covers the franchise route or what the log records.

trust_boundaries.name: corporate network
trust_boundaries.description: The corporate network on which the identity broker and store admin console run.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The broker runs on the corporate network.

trust_boundaries.name: home devices
trust_boundaries.description: The environment containing colleagues' own devices at home.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: including their own devices at home

trust_boundaries.name: franchise environment
trust_boundaries.description: The environment associated with franchise stores and their identity provider.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: We also let the franchise stores in.

assumptions.assumption: The key store's contents are confidential because it holds the signing key.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the key store holds a signing key.

assumptions.assumption: The directory's contents are confidential because it holds colleagues and their group memberships.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the directory holds colleagues and the groups they are in.

assumptions.assumption: The identity broker handles credentials, personal information, secrets, and business-critical identity data.
assumptions.basis: The source describes sign-in credentials, staff IDs, group memberships, signing keys, and authorization tokens handled by the broker.

assumptions.assumption: The store admin console handles financial data because it changes prices and voids transactions.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the console lets a holder change prices and void transactions.

assumptions.assumption: The token flow carries credentials and personal information because the token carries a staff ID and group membership.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the token carries the colleague's staff ID and groups.

assumptions.assumption: The directory flow carries personal information and credentials because it maintains colleague records and group memberships.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the directory contains colleagues and their groups.
